bibl.title: Mixed inks in two Coptic documents from the Hermopolite region relating to lease business
bibl.seg: Lajos Berkes, Grzegorz Nehring, Olivier Bonnerot, Myriam Krutzsch, Ira Rabin & Tonio Sebastian Richter, Mixed Inks in Two Coptic Documents from the Hermopolite Region Relating to Lease Business.
Pylon. Editions and Studies of Ancient Texts 3 (2023) §1-44, figg.
bibl.note: 1. Introduction. - 2. Material Description (M.K.). - 3. Edition of the documents (L.B. & T.S.R.): 3.1. Document declaring exemption from rent (remissio mercedis) [P. Berol. Inv. 11934, Hermopolite, 6th-7th century]; - 3.2. Receipt of land tax received and paid by monks [P. Berol. Inv. 11935, Hermopolite, 7th-8th century]. - 4. Analysis of inks (G.N., O.B. & I.R.). - 5. Conclusions.
